fusions.name: Reaping Arc
fusions.desc: Cuts a cone 4 tiles ahead, dealing 12 damage to everything in it. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Last Furrow
fusions.desc: A strike that deals 10 damage to a target at or below 25% health, consuming every affliction on it and adding 1.6 times their remaining damage to the blow.

fusions.name: Reaper's Lunge
fusions.desc: A short burst of movement that carries you 4 tiles forward. Your movement speed rises 12% for 4s after you use it.

fusions.name: Swath Cleared
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, you regain 4 health a second for 4 seconds. Once every 6 seconds.
